Title: Public preview: Azure Percept DK January (2201) software update is available

Body.Content:
New OS/firmware Over the Air (OTA) package and USB cable update image are available. Review the update strategy guidance before choosing between the two update methods. Updates are highly recommended in order to keep your device up to date with latest fixes and features. 

For latest container updates (2112), please refer to the container release notes and follow the instruction there to update the container through Azure Percept Studio.
